# Lever Jobs Scraper & API - Salary, Remote, Last 24 Hours

> Lever jobs scraper and API for 2,300+ companies on jobs.lever.co, searched live by job title, location, remote, job type and posting date, newest first.

## Summary

Lever Jobs Search is an Apify actor that searches the Lever job sites of 2,300+ companies (jobs.lever.co and jobs.eu.lever.co) at once and returns one row per job, newest first: title, company, location, remote or onsite, job type, department, team, salary with its period, posting date and link. It covers 2,396 job sites of 2,392 companies, which held 76,330 open jobs at 2,056 companies in 140 countries on 2026-11-03, including Palantir, Shield AI, Veeva Systems, Gopuff, Lyra Health, Zoox and Spotify. It reads the public Lever Postings API live at run time with no login and no API key. A third of the jobs publish pay (almost half of the US jobs), and the pay comes with every row, with the period Lever states.

Store: https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/lever-jobs-search
Source: https://github.com/AnshumanAtrey/lever-jobs-search

## Key features

- Every job site on the list at once, read live, with no list of companies needed.
- Salary on the plain row when the company publishes it: currency, amount or range, and the period Lever states (per year, per hour, per month).
- One keyword is enough; an empty form returns the newest jobs of every kind.
- Newest first by the moment the job was created, the date Lever's own job page gives Google.
- Place filter by city, state, country or region: Germany, EMEA, LatAm, Worldwide.
- Lever's EU job sites (jobs.eu.lever.co) included.
- Reads a pasted Google dork such as site:jobs.lever.co/palantir intext:engineer.
- Job link check: each pasted link comes back open, closed or not found.

## Input keys

- Job titles to find (searchTerms): one per line; a job matches when its title has every word.
- Where the job is (location): city, state, country or region; Worldwide finds jobs marked worldwide, global or anywhere.
- Remote or onsite (workType): remote, hybrid or onsite, as the company set it on Lever.
- Posted in the last (postedWithin): 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days, 30 days, any time, or your own period.
- Number of jobs (maxJobs): 100 by default, 0 for every match.
- Full details (includeDetails): adds the description as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its currency and period, country and country code.
- Leave out words (excludeTerms): drops jobs whose title has these words.
- Job type (employmentType): full-time, part-time, contract, intern or temporary, where the company's own words name one.
- Match descriptions (searchDescriptions): finds your words in the description too.
- Only these companies (companies): a name, the name in the address, or a Lever link.
- Job links to check (jobUrls): checks links instead of searching.

## Pricing

PAY_PER_EVENT model, platform usage included:

- Job: $0.0022 per saved job, and per checked link that is closed or not found
- Job with details: $0.0023 per saved job with full details on
- Run start: $0.005 per GB of memory, charged by Apify when a run starts, so $0.01 at the default 2 GB

On paid Apify plans the job prices are 10% less on Scale ($0.00198 and $0.00207) and 20% less on Business and above ($0.00176 and $0.00184); the run start stays $0.005 per GB.

Typical costs (Free and Starter price, default memory):

- 100 newest jobs: $0.23
- 100 jobs with full details: $0.24
- 1,000 jobs: $2.21
- Every job on the list, 76,330 on 2026-11-03: $167.94

Lever has no search, so every search reads all 2,396 job sites, about 81 MB, whatever it finds; the run start pays for that read.

## When to use

- The user wants jobs from companies that hire through Lever, or a jobs.lever.co API.
- The user wants a daily feed of new jobs by title, country or region across 2,300+ companies.
- The user wants jobs with published pay and its period.
- The user wants every open job at one company on Lever, such as Palantir.
- The user wants to check whether Lever job links are still open.

## When NOT to use

- The user needs jobs from companies on another applicant tracking system: use greenhouse-jobs-search, ashby-jobs-search, workday-job-search or a multi-ATS actor.
- The user needs a fast search across every company: each search reads all 2,396 job sites.
- The user wants one row per job opening when a company posts a copy per country: Jobgether posts one per country, 5.6% of the jobs on 2026-11-03 but most of the newest ones.

## Sample input

```json
{
  "searchTerms": ["software engineer"],
  "location": ["United States", "Canada"],
  "postedWithin": "7 days",
  "maxJobs": 100
}
```

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- vs fantastic-jobs/lever-co-jobs-api ($0.0025 per job; $0.002, $0.0012 and $0.0008 on paid plans): a stored database of Lever jobs posted in the last 6 months, with fields added by AI; this actor reads every job site live, so it also returns the open jobs created earlier (35.5% of them on 2026-11-03), and costs less per job on the free plan (with the run start, runs of 34 jobs or more cost less).
- vs yugenox/ats-jobs-search ($0.002 per job, no start fee): cheaper, gives pay periods and job types too, and reads Greenhouse and Ashby as well; when a search finds few jobs per board it stops after the largest boards (at least the 500 largest, by its own page), while this actor reads all 2,396 Lever job sites on every search, Lever's 85 EU sites included.
- vs bovi/greenhouse-lever-ashby-job-scraper ($0.0015 per job): cheaper per job, but it reads only the companies you name or its curated preset lists; this actor searches all 2,396 job sites on its list at once.
- vs fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api ($0.012 per job, $0.01 start): many more platforms from a stored database; this actor costs less per job and reads Lever live.
